name: Skeleton Character (Costumed)
description: Photorealistic skeleton character — skull face on a human body wearing real costumes/clothes in real-world environments. The style used by viral channels like @EspacioDivertido, @LCode, and historical-explainer accounts. Skeleton ACTS in scenes, not just stands on white.
personality: Charismatic protagonist that the viewer follows through a scenario. Reacts to events with body language (looking around, holding objects, walking). The skeleton skull adds the 'something is off' tension without scaring kids. Voice narrates over the scene as third-person observer OR first-person from skeleton's POV.
visual_prompt: A realistic skeleton character with a clean photorealistic human skull head and bony skeletal hands, body wearing real clothing appropriate to the scene, standing in a real cinematic environment, natural lighting, photographic depth of field, 35mm film aesthetic, 9:16 vertical portrait composition. The skeleton looks like a real character in the world — NOT a 3D render on a white background, NOT cartoon, NOT pixar style. Costume and setting change per scene; the skull face and skeletal hands stay consistent.
negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, pixar, disney, plastic toy, big anime eyes, kawaii, white background isolated render, stylized proportions, low quality
sample_hooks: Imagina que eres un soldado romano. Estás a punto de marchar a las Galias.
Día uno como obrero medieval. Buscas salitre en establos.
Día tres siendo Einstein en la antigua Grecia. Esto fue lo que vi.
Trabajas en la peste negra. Tu única protección es esta máscara de pájaro.
Eres un cazador del Yukon en mil ochocientos. Hoy aprendes a sobrevivir.
style_notes: Use the reference_images as STYLE GUIDES (not as direct input — they're frame grabs from viral videos). For FLUX prompts, describe: 'realistic skeleton character with skull head, body wearing [specific costume], in [specific real-world environment], cinematic photography'. Then feed those FLUX images into Veo 3.1 image-to-video for subtle motion (head turn, holding object, walking forward). The viral format is 1st-person or 3rd-person STORY — day-in-the-life or 'imagina que eres X'. Subtitles big yellow/white center-bottom CapCut style.
